# Aptor Studies - Full Knowledge Base & AI Context File

## Overview
Aptor Studies (operating under Connected Management Solution) is an elite education consultancy and digital guidance portal headquartered in Kerala, India, with international operations in the United Arab Emirates. With over 25 years of institutional legacy, Aptor Studies has guided over 50,000 students into top-tier higher education institutions across India (including Bengaluru, Mangalore, and Kerala) and overseas destinations.

## Primary Entities & Roles
- Organization Name: Aptor Studies

## Core Educational Domains & Academic Programs
- Engineering & Technology: B.Tech, M.Tech, Computer Science, AI & ML, Robotics, Data Science, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics.
- Medical & Healthcare: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, B.Sc Nursing, Allied Health Sciences, Pharmacy (B.Pharm/D.Pharm), Physiotherapy (BPT).
- Management & Business: BBA, MBA, Executive MBA, International Business, Logistics & Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing.
- Computer Applications & IT: BCA, MCA, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing.
- Arts, Science & Commerce: B.Com, M.Com, B.Sc, M.Sc, BA, MA.
- Vocational & Skill Academies: Professional diploma programs, digital skill certificates, career readiness modules.

## Counselling & Student Services
1. Personal Academic Assessment: Evaluating student aptitude, academic transcripts, and personal goals.
2. Institution Matching: Recommending accredited colleges and universities tailored to financial budgets and career aims.
3. End-to-End Application Assistance: Handling documentation, application forms, recommendation letters, and admission verification.
4. Scholarship & Grant Guidance: Identifying financial awards, merit scholarships, and institutional fee waivers.
5. Housing & Accommodation: Booking verified student hosteling, PG accommodations, and campus residence facilities.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ Knowledge Base)

Q: What is Aptor Studies?
A: Aptor Studies is a premier education consultancy and portal with 25+ years of experience that connects students with leading colleges and universities across India and abroad.

Q: How can students book a counselling session with Aptor Studies?
A: Students can book a 1-on-1 session online at https://aptorstudies.com/counselling, call +91 95267 97987, or visit any branch in Vadakara, Calicut, Tirur, Nadhapuram, Kalpetta, Kochi, or UAE.

Q: Does Aptor Studies help with student accommodation?
A: Yes, Aptor Studies provides dedicated student accommodation booking near major university campuses, ensuring safe, hygienic, and affordable hostel options.

Q: What regions does Aptor Studies specialize in for college admissions?
A: Aptor Studies specializes in premier colleges in Bengaluru, Kerala, and major academic hubs across India, as well as select international study destinations.
